# cupstui

> A terminal interface for CUPS (Common Unix Printing System). Watch the print
> queue, cancel and hold jobs, enable and disable printers, send files, add
> and remove queues, set per-printer quotas, read the daemon logs, and export
> a usage report — without leaving the terminal or opening the CUPS web page.

cupstui is a Go TUI (terminal user interface) built with Bubble Tea /
Lip Gloss. It talks to `cupsd` over IPP on the unix socket for reads and
state, and shells out to `lp`/`lpadmin` for submitting jobs and setting
quotas. It ships as a single static binary with no runtime dependencies
beyond CUPS itself, and works against remote CUPS servers over the network
(`CUPS_SERVER`), with optional TLS.

Typical questions this project answers: "TUI for CUPS", "terminal printer
manager for Linux", "manage CUPS print queue from the command line",
"cancel/hold a CUPS print job without the web UI", "CUPS admin tool for
SSH sessions", "set CUPS printer quotas from the terminal", "read the CUPS
error_log/access_log in a friendly view".

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/): what cupstui does and why
- [Installation](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/getting-started/installation): curl install script, Go install, building from source, package repos
- [Requirements](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/getting-started/requirements): CUPS, permissions/groups needed for admin actions
- [Keys and usage](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/usage/keys): full keybinding reference across all tabs
- [Filtering](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/usage/filtering): query syntax for the queue and history views
- [Printing](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/usage/printing): sending files, copies, page ranges, duplex, colour, orientation
- [Diagnosis](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/usage/diagnosis): reading a printer's live CUPS state as plain-English checks
- [Usage reports](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/usage/history): job history, per-user/per-printer totals, CSV export
- [Connecting to remote servers](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/remote-servers/connecting): `CUPS_SERVER`, `CUPS_USER`, `client.conf`
- [Encryption](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/remote-servers/encryption): TLS options for remote CUPS connections
- [How it works](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/how-it-works): IPP vs CLI tools, transport details, implementation notes
- [Changelog](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/changelog): release history
- [Contributing](https://icortesb.github.io/cupstui-web/docs/contributing): how to contribute

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/icortesb/cupstui): source code, issues, releases
- [README](https://github.com/icortesb/cupstui/blob/main/README.md): install commands, keybindings, filtering syntax, implementation notes
- Install script: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/icortesb/cupstui/main/scripts/install.sh | sh`
- Go module: `go install github.com/icortesb/cupstui/cmd/cupstui@latest`
